description: Wever Checks: submit a product listing (title, description, price, currency, image_urls and attribute fields) and get a signed report on missing fields, image presence and reachability for the URLs supplied (one header read each), and price sanity against the listing’s own stated attributes: msrp or original price, cost or floor, quantity and prices quoted in the text. It checks the listing as submitted. POST /api/listing-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/checks/.

inputSchema.description: The listing exactly as it will be submitted.

fields.description: Listing attributes such as brand, condition, category, size, color, quantity, sku, msrp, original_price or cost.

image_urls.description: Up to 24 image URLs, in listing order.

marketplace.description: Where the listing will go, recorded as context.

required_fields.description: Names to require. Top-level names (title, description, price, currency, image_urls) or attribute names from fields. Replaces the default set.

name: wever_listing-check
title: Listing check
